title: Thai Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with chicken, noodles, and a blend of Thai spices. Serve hot and enjoy!

ingredients.name: zesty sauce
ingredients.notes: Thai red curry paste or store-bought

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the noodles, zesty sauce, and peanuts to the skillet.
Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
Add the basil and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: add your favorite vegetables (e.g. bell peppers, carrots) to the stir-fry for added flavor and nutrition.
